question.text: The principal officer of a PMS applicant must have a minimum of how many years of related experience in the securities market?

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM-Series-X-A (p.227) requires the principal officer to have a minimum of five years of related experience in securities market activities. Page 228 separately prescribes a minimum of two years of experience for another employee of the portfolio manager. The Trap: The 2-year figure relates to another employee of the portfolio manager on p.228, not to the principal officer. Note: Qualitative claims about team depth, leadership track record, or risk management are not in the checked PMS personnel pages and should be cited from a separate source before being asserted.
